```{r}
# Installing Necessary Packages
install.packages("tidyverse") # for cleaning, organizing, joining, and visualizing data
install.packages("janitor") # for cleaning column names
install.packages("scales") # for formatting percentages and lables
install.packages("here") # for navigating file paths

# Loading Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(here)
```
```{r}
# Importing patient data
patients <- read_csv(here("data", "patients.csv")) %>%
  clean_names()

# Importing medication data
medications <- read_csv(here("data", "medications.csv")) %>%
  clean_names()

# Importing condition data
conditions <- read_csv(here("data", "conditions.csv")) %>%
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
# Establishing how many unique patients exist within sample and whether all medication records belong to those patients

# Checking total number of patient records
nrow(patients)

# Checking number of unique patient IDs
n_distinct(patients$id)

# Checking for duplicate patient IDs
patients %>%
  count(id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# Calculating number of unique patients represented in medications
n_distinct(medications$patient)

# Calculating number of unique patients represented in conditions
n_distinct(conditions$patient)

# Calculating number of medication records without a matching patient
anti_join(
  medications,
  patients,
  by = c("patient" = "id")
) %>%
  nrow()

# The result of this confirmed that there are 111 unique patients with no duplicated patient IDs. Every medication record belong to a patient bu there are only 107 patients with records and 4 without. All patients, however, have condition records. 
```

```{r}
# Creating waffle chart visualization to show many patients within our sample have medication records 

# Counting patients with and without medication records
waffle_data <- patients %>%
  mutate(
    medication_status = if_else(
      id %in% medications$patient,
      "Has medication records",
      "No medication records"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(medication_status) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100
  )

# Checking results
waffle_data

# Creating one square for each patient
waffle_squares <- patients %>%
  mutate(
    medication_status = if_else(
      id %in% medications$patient,
      "Has medication records",
      "No medication records"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(medication_status) %>%
  mutate(
    square = row_number(),
    x = (square - 1) %% 11,
    y = 10 - ((square - 1) %/% 11)
  )

# Creating waffle chart
waffle_chart <- ggplot(waffle_squares, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = medication_status)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    "Has medication records" = "#1F4E79",
    "No medication records" = "#BDBDBD"
  )
) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Medication Records Are Present for Nearly All Patients",
    subtitle = "96.4% of sample patients have at least one medication record",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Each square represents one patient.",
      "Source: Synthea, an open-source synthetic patient population simulator."
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 15, face = "bold", color = "#263238"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 13, color = "#455A64"
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 7, color = "#607D8B", hjust = 0,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 30)
  )

# Saving chart to figures folder within project directory
ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "visualization_1_waffle_chart.png"),
  plot = waffle_chart,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
```{r}
#Visualizing the distribution of medication counts per patient differ across age groups

# Counting medication records for each patient
patient_medication_counts <- patients %>%
  left_join(
    medications %>%
      count(patient, name = "medication_count"),
    by = c("id" = "patient")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    medication_count = replace_na(medication_count, 0)
  )

# Checking the results
patient_medication_counts %>%
  summarise(
    total_patients = n(),
    patients_with_records = sum(medication_count > 0),
    patients_without_records = sum(medication_count == 0),
    total_medication_records = sum(medication_count)
  )

# Calculating patient age and assign age groups
patient_medication_counts <- patient_medication_counts %>%
  mutate(
    age = floor(
      lubridate::time_length(
        lubridate::interval(birthdate, as.Date("2026-11-15")),
        "years"
      )
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      age <= 17 ~ "0–17",
      age <= 34 ~ "18–34",
      age <= 49 ~ "35–49",
      age <= 64 ~ "50–64",
      age >= 65 ~ "65+"
    )
  )

# Checking the distribuion
patient_medication_counts %>%
  count(age_group)

# Summarizing medication counts within each age group
patient_medication_counts %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    zero_medications = sum(medication_count == 0),
    min_medications = min(medication_count),
    median_medications = median(medication_count),
    mean_medications = round(mean(medication_count), 1),
    max_medications = max(medication_count)
  )

# Defining Categories of Medication Counts
patient_medication_counts <- patient_medication_counts %>%
  mutate(
    medication_category = case_when(
      medication_count == 0 ~ "0",
      medication_count <= 5 ~ "1–5",
      medication_count <= 10 ~ "6–10",
      medication_count <= 20 ~ "11–20",
      medication_count > 20 ~ "21+"
    )
  )

# Examining distribution across age groups
patient_medication_counts %>%
  count(age_group, medication_category) %>%
  arrange(age_group, medication_category)
```

```{r}
# Setting the correct category order
patient_medication_counts <- patient_medication_counts %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("0–17", "18–34", "35–49", "50–64", "65+")
    ),
    medication_category = factor(
      medication_category,
      levels = c("0", "1–5", "6–10", "11–20", "21+")
    )
  )

# Calculating percentages for each age group
medication_distribution <- patient_medication_counts %>%
  count(age_group, medication_category) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    age_group,
    medication_category,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Checking results
medication_distribution


# Creating the stacked bar chart
medication_chart <- ggplot(
  medication_distribution,
  aes(x = age_group, y = percentage, fill = medication_category)
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0" = "#E5E7EB",
      "1–5" = "#C6D5E5",
      "6–10" = "#8EABC8",
      "11–20" = "#527A9F",
      "21+" = "#1F4E79"
    ),
    breaks = c("0", "1–5", "6–10", "11–20", "21+"),
    limits = c("0", "1–5", "6–10", "11–20", "21+")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Older Age Groups Have a Higher Share of Patients with 21+ Medication Records",
    subtitle = "Percentage of patients in each age group by total recorded medication count",
    x = "Patient age group",
    y = "Percentage of patients",
    fill = "Medication records per patient",
    caption = paste(
      "Each bar represents 100% of patients within an age group.",
      "Medication records may reflect historical records, not current prescriptions.",
      "Source: Synthea, an open-source synthetic patient population simulator."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14, face = "bold", color = "#263238"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11, color = "#455A64"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "#455A64"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "#455A64"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8, color = "#607D8B", hjust = 0,
      lineheight = 1.3
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 20)
  )

medication_chart
```

```{r}
summary(medications$start)
summary(medications$stop)

max(medications$start, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculating currently active medication records
reference_date <- as.POSIXct(
  "2026-10-16 23:59:59",
  tz = "UTC"
)

active_medications <- medications %>%
  filter(
    start <= reference_date,
    is.na(stop) | stop > reference_date
  )

# Checking how many records are currently active
nrow(active_medications)

# Checking how many unique patients have active medication records
n_distinct(active_medications$patient)

# Calculating medication counts per patient
active_patient_counts <- patients %>%
  left_join(
    active_medications %>%
      count(patient, name = "active_medication_count"),
    by = c("id" = "patient")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    active_medication_count = replace_na(
      active_medication_count, 0
    )
  )

# Verifying totals
active_patient_counts %>%
  summarise(
    total_patients = n(),
    patients_with_active_medications =
      sum(active_medication_count > 0),
    patients_without_active_medications =
      sum(active_medication_count == 0),
    total_active_medication_records =
      sum(active_medication_count)
  )
```
```{r}
# Creating medication-count categories
active_patient_counts <- active_patient_counts %>%
  mutate(
    medication_category = case_when(
      active_medication_count == 0 ~ "0",
      active_medication_count <= 5 ~ "1–5",
      active_medication_count <= 10 ~ "6–10",
      active_medication_count <= 20 ~ "11–20",
      active_medication_count > 20 ~ "21+"
    )
  )

# Count patients in each category
active_patient_counts %>%
  count(medication_category) %>%
  arrange(medication_category)
```
```{r}
# Breaking down active medication count by age
active_patient_counts <- active_patient_counts %>%
  mutate(
    age = floor(
      lubridate::time_length(
        lubridate::interval(
          birthdate,
          as.Date("2026-10-16")
        ),
        "years"
      )
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      age <= 17 ~ "0–17",
      age <= 34 ~ "18–34",
      age <= 49 ~ "35–49",
      age <= 64 ~ "50–64",
      age >= 65 ~ "65+"
    )
  )

active_patient_counts %>%
  count(age_group, medication_category) %>%
  arrange(age_group, medication_category) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
```{r}
# Updating percentages
active_distribution <- active_patient_counts %>%
  mutate(

      medication_category,
      levels = c("0", "1–5", "6–10", "11–20")

active_distribution
```
